Space Invasion (Space Invasion (Page 22)) Fujiali stood in front of the glass curtain wall, her light golden eyes staring unblinkingly at the ball of light below that was breaking through the seal. Behind her, a knight in silver armor stepped forward half a step, with his right hand on his chest: "Holy Lady, we are now -" "Help." After that, Fujiali's figure also disappeared in an instant. She ignored the restrictions jointly set by the professors, and instantly The space penetrated the subspace barrier. The light spread out in front of her, like an endless sea. The scene in front of her was no longer the same as before. The forest had been completely wiped out, and there was only a scorched earth, as if it had been plowed by the sky. The sky was no longer a sky, but an endless ocean of light, as if someone had destroyed it. The whole sun was thrown into this folded space, letting it pour. Laches's figure was flying between the sky and the earth, avoiding the crushing light rain in the sky. His other hand held a silvery halo, and inside the halo, a curled figure was wrapped in layers. Chloe. Fujiali's eyes stayed on him for a moment, and then she looked away and looked again. Looking at the sky. Because the sea of light was roaring with a name, "Luo Yi!!!!" She saw Laches' figure constantly changing directions in the rain of light, like an eagle being chased by the rain. The light spears fell from the sky faster and faster, and they passed by the edge of his robe several times, leaving large dents in the scorched earth. After that, Laches would respond with a stream of silvery white light in a very short gap. Those streams of light exploded in mid-air, turning into rotating wind blades or intertwined light nets, and slashed towards the sky. They caused brief ripples, and then were swallowed up. But those short-lived ripples did slow down the expansion of the sea of light for an instant. Laches had already seen Fujiali the moment she landed. He did not slow down, and his voice exploded as he moved quickly: "He is infecting this subspace! He wants to transform it into his kingdom of God! Stop him!" Outside the venue, people flowed out from all exits like an ebbing tide. Evelyn stood at the top of the venue, calmly watching this scene, only after the last figure disappeared from the entrance to the shelter, she looked back, then raised her hand, and placed her fingertips on it. With a slight flicker in the air, a green barrier instantly enveloped the entire venue. The next moment, her figure disappeared and appeared inside the venue. At this moment, the temperature here had climbed to a terrifying level. Some of the originally neatly arranged seats had even begun to soften and bend downward like baked wax strips. The huge silver sphere is no longer there. Instead, there is a luminous sphere with a diameter of nearly 100 meters, which is suspended in the center of the venue, with a stream of golden light as hot as lava flowing on its surface. There are already dozens of professors coming from all over the academy. But even if this group of professors, who are all at the beginning of the imperial level, jointly arrange a ban, they are completely unable to stop the continuous expansion of this sphere of light.
